Method of Attack: Arbitrary file read/inclusion vulnerability due to AJP protocol support in Tomcat being enabled by default
Attack Vector: The attacker can use this vulnerability to read arbitrary files from the affected server via AJP connections, or perform Remote Code Execution (RCE) by uploading files of certain types
Indicators of Compromise: Arbitrary file access, potential for remote code execution
